title: Points of a scheme over a field with values in a field extension, and their number
statement:
Let $k_0$ be a field, $Y_0$ a scheme over $k_0$ with structure morphism $f:Y_0\to\operatorname{Spec}k_0$, and $K$ a field extension of $k_0$; write $\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}k_0$ for the morphism induced by the inclusion $k_0\to K$. The set of *$K$-valued points* of $Y_0$ over $k_0$ is

$$
 Y_0(K)=\operatorname{Hom}_{k_0}(\operatorname{Spec}K,Y_0)
 =\{\,g:\operatorname{Spec}K\to Y_0\ :\ f\circ g=(\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}k_0)\,\},
$$

the set of morphisms of schemes over $\operatorname{Spec}k_0$ from $\operatorname{Spec}K$ to $Y_0$. When $Y_0(K)$ is a finite set, $\#Y_0(K)\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$ denotes its number of elements.

source.place: §27 (Integrality), p. 157: "A point of $X_0$ with coordinates in $\mathbf F_{q^m}$ is a map $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf F_{q^m}\to X_0$"; §26, p. 151: "$N_m$ the number of points on $X_0$ with coordinates in $\mathbf F_{q^m}$"

mathlib_searches.results: only Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/EllipticCurve/LFunction.lean and EllipticCurve/Affine/Point.lean (affine points of a Weierstrass curve), not the scheme-theoretic notion

mathlib_searches.query: grep -n 'def Over\|protected def Over.Hom' Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Comma/Over/Basic.lean; grep -n 'IsOver\|CanonicallyOver\|asOver' Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Over.lean
mathlib_searches.results: Over/Basic.lean:39 `def Over (X : T) := CostructuredArrow (𝟭 T) X`, line 43 `Over.Hom f g := CommaMorphism f g` (a morphism `g.left ⟶ f.left` with the commutation `w`); AlgebraicGeometry/Over.lean:46 `Hom.IsOver f S` with `isOver_iff : f.IsOver S ↔ f ≫ Y ↘ S = X ↘ S` (line 49), `asOver` (55), `Hom.asOver` (58)
mathlib_searches.verdict: generalization: hom types of the over category; specializes in one line

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: `Y₀(K)` is the hom type `Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k₀ K))) ⟶ Over.mk f` in `Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))`, whose elements are morphisms `g : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Y₀` with `g ≫ f = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k₀ K))`; its number of elements is `Nat.card` of that type (Mathlib/SetTheory/Cardinal/Finite.lean:41, value 0 when infinite); the scheme-level packaging is `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.IsOver` (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Over.lean:46)

lean_notes: The source repository defines exactly this subtype as `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.fieldPoints f K := {g : Spec (.of K) ⟶ X // g ≫ f = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))}` (Comparator/Weil/Definitions.lean:85, module `Weil.Definitions`, both branches, sorry-free) and the count as `Hom.pointCount f n := Nat.card (f.fieldPoints (FiniteField.galoisExtension k n))` (line 91), with `FiniteField.galoisExtension k n` (line 67) a model of the degree-n extension; `Hom.nat_card_fieldPoints_congr` (WeilConjectures/ZetaSeries.lean:172) shows the count does not depend on the model.
